The '''Onderon highlands''' were a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range to the east of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].

==History==
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|droid occupation]] was present on Onderon under the rule of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]]. During the crisis, the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] thought of bringing the droid forces within these highlands to fight rather than in the city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] to keep the people safe and preventing them to get caught in the crossfire. The highlands was also home to [[The nest/Legends|the nest]].
